rationale.UNH: Managed-care leader down ~33% in 2025 on utilization/DOJ fears; ~14x earnings, deep mean-reversion candidate
rationale.PFE: Ultra-cheap pharma (~8-9x), high dividend yield, pipeline pessimism overdone
rationale.BMY: Low P/E, high FCF yield, dividend support; flat 2025 leaves cheap re-rating room
rationale.ELV: Cheap (~11x) managed-care insurer beaten down alongside UNH; contrarian mean-reversion pair
rationale.CMCSA: Cheap cable/broadband at ~8-9x FCF, down ~17%, buybacks and dividend
rationale.PYPL: Fintech at ~12x with heavy buybacks, down ~32%, turnaround optionality
rationale.NKE: Beaten-down consumer brand (-11%) mid-turnaround under new management
rationale.CVX: Cheap integrated energy, high FCF yield and secure dividend, diversifier vs AI trade
rationale.TGT: Cheap retailer (~12x) down ~26%; sentiment washed out, dividend aristocrat
rationale.KHC: Ultra-cheap staples (~9x) down ~16% with potential breakup/restructuring catalyst

backtest.notes: Naive most-beaten-down contrarian baskets lagged hard in 2024 (momentum/AI dominance) and matched SPY in 2025; final picks avoid already-reverted names (e.g., CVS +87% in 2025) and favor cheap names with identifiable catalysts.
